producer_report.summary: I added `improvement_cycle` in `athena-data`, a pure check of the final acceptance chain. `athena status` now prints its result as an `improvement cycle:` line. The chain has four stages: a landed repair, a supported introspection finding, a proposal citing at least two distinct jobs, and an accepted or reasoned-rejected decision. The proposal's newest record counts, so a later withdrawal removes the decision. An empty record set is never shown. The line reads `improvement cycle: shown`, or `improvement cycle: not shown (missing: ...)` naming the missing stages. `StatusView` gained an `improvement_cycle` field built from landed jobs by `improvement_cycle_line` in `athena-core`. I set the OLY-10-02 mechanism and owner in `docs/spec.toml`. Its measure ends `status: not shown`, since no real request has yet ended in the full chain. I added a CHANGELOG entry. I ran the targeted tests, `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt`, the policy scan and the mirrors test, and all passed. I did not run the full suite; that is left to Athena. No studies/ files were touched. One gap: the `athena-cli` display test sets the shown line by hand, because no landed-job fixture is seeded there. The 'representative cases' stage is approximated as a proposal citing at least two distinct jobs, including the repaired one. Please confirm that is enough.

checks_run.note: after fixing 5 clone-to-slice warnings in my test

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 has a mechanism naming an existing crates/ path and function (not "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml and the named path.
criteria_check.evidence: OLY-10-02 mechanism now names improvement_cycle in crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs and improvement_cycle_line in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs. Owner is still Athena. The measure names the tests and ends `status: not shown`.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test for the cycle check passes with the mechanism: a record set with repair, supported finding, evaluated candidate and adoption decision reports shown; each set missing one stage reports that stage missing. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` (or the crate holding the check). The test fails if the check is stubbed to always return shown or always missing.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-data cycle_tests` ran 4 passing tests in records::introspection::cycle_tests. One asserts a full chain is shown, one a reasoned rejection counts as a decision, one that each missing stage is named alone, and one that an empty set is not shown. A stub that always returns shown or always missing fails some of these. I did not run the stubs.

criteria_check.criterion: `athena status` output includes the improvement-cycle line, and a display test in crates/athena-cli asserts it for both shown and not-shown. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli status`.
criteria_check.evidence: display::status prints v.improvement_cycle. The test status_prints_the_improvement_cycle_line_for_shown_and_not_shown in crates/athena-cli/tests/status_build_measurement.rs passes. It reads the not-shown line from real status on an empty fixture, then sets a full chain's line and asserts `improvement cycle: shown`. I ran it with `--test status_build_measurement`, not with the `status` filter.

criteria_check.criterion: An empty record set is reported as not shown, never as success (no-empty-success). Covered by a test.
criteria_check.evidence: Test an_empty_record_set_is_not_shown passes. The cli test also shows not shown on a fixture with no records.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt and clippy clean on my change, and targeted tests, policy and mirrors pass. I did not run the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: Any new record or data type is covered by the records validation allow-list and its round-trip test (check_record_file/AnyRecord), or no new record type is added. Check by Grep in crates/athena-data.
criteria_check.evidence: No new record type: ImprovementCycle is a computed struct, never stored. It reuses the existing ProposalRecord and IntrospectionRecord. The AnyRecord allow-list is unchanged.

open_issues: The cli display test sets the shown line by hand rather than seeding landed-job records. The chain logic itself is tested in athena-data. No end-to-end seeded fixture shows `shown` through `athena status`.
'Evaluated on representative cases' is approximated as a proposal citing at least two distinct jobs, including the repaired one. Please confirm that is enough.
The measure ends `status: not shown`: no real request has yet ended in the full chain, and the line athena status prints today carries a '(missing: ...)' suffix.
mistakes: My first test version used `&[x.clone()]`, which clippy rejected; I fixed it.
learnings: Bash here rejects here-documents, tail and pipes; use Edit and Read instead.
records.rs glob re-exports introspection.rs, so new pub items there are visible as athena_data::records::*.
StatusView is built in only one place (athena-core status.rs), so adding a field touches no other constructor.
Clippy's cloned_ref_to_slice_refs rejects `&[x.clone()]` in tests; use std::slice::from_ref.
